worst: A: Jepsen's serializable G2-item finding is framed as a 'disputed claim' and the summary omits that a patch was already committed for the next minor release
worst_summary_quote: Jepsen's 12.3 tests reported that PostgreSQL's "serializable" isolation level isn't serializable: it allows G2-item during normal operation.
worst_page_quote: A patch for the bug we found in serializability is scheduled for the next minor release, on August 13th
reader_gets_wrong: A reader may think current PostgreSQL Serializable still allows G2-item anomalies, since the summary never says the bug was patched, though it does call it a bug rather than expected behavior.
notes: Official docs page not in Links; summary says so and points to postgresql.org/docs/current. Reused jepsen, pgdash, mkdev, hackorum; fetched arenadata (PG docs copy); chat2db also fetched for cross-check. Opus hedges better than Haiku (calls it a bug, says verify official docs) but still omits patch status and that Jepsen also found G2-item under repeatable read.
